notes.title: Aenaon is here and within ancient Greece
notes.content:
Remember when you wished for a journey to the times of Zeus and
Athena? When you dreamt about your winning entrance to the stadium
of Olympia, as the winner of the everlasting Olympic Games- everybody
cheers for you and you only! Well, the time is now; and forever.

Aenaon- The return of Ancient Greece and Back takes you to an exciting journey
to Ancient Greece. As the main character, determined to explore
yourself and your capabilities, you will set on an adventure from
the colonies in Massalia (France), to Poseidonia in South Italy.
Before you dock to Greece and head towards Olympia, you will share
your days with Socrates, Pythagoras, the Olympian Gods: this is not
a journey as usual. It is the path to knowledge and strength, to
sports and friendship. A course that lasts forever- this is exactly
what Aenaon means.

Aenaon- The return of Ancient Greece is adventurous and educational
a game that makes the most of the virtual reality features to recreate
the experience of those times- in terms of action and thinking. The
morals of Greek Philosophers inspire dilemmas that will craft the
the character of Diagoras (and the player) and will lead to the essence
of the Olympic Games: it is the joy of participation and the
posthumous fame that really matters. Through the routes of Mythology
and History, we bring back to life an era that founded our
civilization- and now, you can be a part of it.
Are you ready for eternal glory?

notes.title: New DLC from Aenaon- Athlon ancient sports compertion
notes.content:
Athlon is referring to sports in ancient Greece. Also means feat, accomplishment, snorter as we remember The twelve Labours of Heracles.

Υou can participate in a competition that has the following sports

* Running or Diavlos (ran at 200 and 400 meters)
* Javelin or Akodio (throw the javelin as far as you can)
* Wrestling or Pali (fight to stay Υou, the only one standing)
* Horse racing or Ippodromies (ride your horses faster than anyone)
* Archery or Toxovolia (Your target is at 200 and 400 meters)

You think you are best?

We think its time for you, to practice your athletic skills

It is a game that everyone can play, as long as, they have a fighting spirit and noble rivalry
